reviews.title: Be aware!!!
reviews.body:
This app is an alarming invasion of privacy!

What I discovered, completely unbeknownst to me, is that user profiles and closets are set to PUBLIC by default. This means that anyone who comes across your profile, or simply knows your name and searches for you, can browse your entire virtual closet and see virtually everything you own that you’ve uploaded to the app.

I find this extremely disturbing and unacceptable. I had absolutely no idea that my personal closet was publicly accessible until I accidentally discovered it.

It is incredibly irresponsible of the developers to make users’ private wardrobes public by default. Privacy should be the default setting, and users should have to actively choose to make their profiles public if they wish to share that information.

People should not have to discover by accident that their personal information and belongings are being exposed to strangers. This is a serious privacy issue that needs to be addressed immediately.

reviews.title: Does not consider time
reviews.body:
The app doesn’t allow you to input how much time you’ve owned a piece, so ratings about your wardrobe’s sustainability are mostly superficial and related to brand, not whether or not you’ve kept your clothes from going in the dumpster. Many sustainability problems have to do with waste. 

A Reformation dress that you wear once and throw away is not necessarily sustainable, even though the brand rates very highly on this app. 

It’s a well designed enough app, with some cool features, but for anyone whose been into sustainability for a while, it lacks nuance. The app seems mostly like a way to encourage shoppers to buy expensive brands, which not all of us can afford. 

An H&M shirt that you’ve had for five years is still sustainable - in its own way. The most important part is keeping your clothes and caring for them in whatever way you can to avoid creating waste. 

If you’re new to these concepts the app might be fun, if not, I wouldn’t recommend it for the purposes of sustainability

reviews.body:
Use this app for many years and it’s been really fine. I probably made time from vacation and see what’s in my closet. The feature I would love to have is the ability to make and store outfits with wish list and/or inspiration items. I currently have a wishlist category in the closet for this, but I don’t like how it is stored and included in the style stats as if it were in my closet. Sometimes I just like seeing how new items fit with my current clothes, and it helps to have a new shirt with no background to overlay on current closet items. The inspiration list doesn’t have an option to save clothing items without backgrounds, so when I add them to looks, they don’t layer well with the other items.

It would also be cool to integrate the weather app somehow. When planning outfits for the week or just the next day, it would be nice not to have to go to the weather app to check what kind of weather I should dress for. 

Overall been using Stylebook for years, and I love it so much!

reviews.body:

reviews.title: 希望增加灵感看板功能
reviews.body:
终于找到想要的 APP 了，但还是有一些没有达到预期，提一些我的小小建议，希望可以采纳
1.希望真正是一个好的工具，而不是一个为淘宝导流的 APP。毕竟大家的衣服并不都是来自淘宝。
更开发者可以强调它的工具属性，把社区和购买的建议放在后面。不然会像蘑菇街一样黄掉。
2.希望可以方便的在图片上增加描述文字，做出来的效果类似于日本杂志那样。现在的备注在最下方，有点不起眼了。
3.因为衣帽间都有不同的衣柜。
希望给不同类型的衣服进行分区，比如说运动的、职场的、周末的。这样不会所有的衣服堆在同一个衣柜里，会比较混乱。
4.除了已经购买的衣服，希望可以增加梦想衣橱的功能。可以放在不同的文件夹或者专门标注出来。很多在收藏夹或者购物车里的衣服，我需要专门的文件夹来收藏，考察一下再下单购买，所以我很需要这样的一个功能。有时候也需要拿来和现有的衣服做搭配，来看看是否真的需要购买。
感谢，感恩做出这么好的 APP 来给我们用

reviews.title: 一些使用建议
reviews.body:
1:希望抠图功能可以完善下，这个毛病真的很大。有时候自动抠图把需要的部分抠掉了，但是没有手动涂抹恢复的功能，如果不用自动抠图，自己用橡皮擦一点点擦又实在太麻烦了。

3:拼图那里希望从相册导入的时候就可以有一件抠图的功能，不用一件件抠。
4:输入一个衣服新品牌的时候，确认了之后希望可以自动填选该品牌，就不用从列表里再重新找出来了。
5:为什么导入穿搭的时候不可以多件自动抠图啊，像导入衣服那样。
6:如果能接入 AI 就好了，现在 ai 是大趋势。有些衣服不管是自己拍还是从网购网站拿的图都不够好看，而且不够清楚，能 ai 一件抠成白底图并且恢复衣服整体样貌就好了。
